scope: All 108 names: the text was compared name by name with the page images of the TTD book (pp. 47–48), and every meaning was read against its name. There are no word-by-word glosses on this page (the meanings are per name). The range-number flags are the block labels. prāṇāya (95) and the corrections of plain misprints are as SOURCES §12.2 records.

items.issue: Name 91 read kāraṇotpattidehāya, taken over from the Wikisource stotra; the print has kāraṇopāttadehāya (“who took on a body for a purpose”), the reading other lists also have.
items.change: Restored to the print, with its meaning.

items.issue: Name 54, agnigarbhāya, was “womb of fire”; Skanda is the child Agni carried, not the womb.
items.change: Now “the child Fire carried” (the same gloss is corrected on the stotra page).
